zh.title: 霍兰德职业兴趣：结果解读与职业探索工作表
zh.intro: 记录你的六维兴趣与探索计划。它不是测评问卷、SDS 或 O*NET 官方题本，也不是自动生成的个人报告。

pages.title: 一、记录与理解兴趣线索

sections.heading: 记录版本和完整分布
sections.body: 先完成费马现有的 60 题或 140 题测试，再记录结果。分数按本站题目量尺展示，不是人群百分位、能力分或就业成功率。
prompts: R 实际型：____  I 研究型：____  A 艺术型：____
S 社会型：____  E 企业型：____  C 常规型：____

sections.heading: 把字母还原成活动
sections.body: R 偏向动手实践；I 偏向研究分析；A 偏向创作表达；S 偏向帮助与教学；E 偏向组织与影响；C 偏向数据、规则与秩序。六类可以并存，排序不是能力排名。
prompts: 最近喜欢并愿意再做的两项活动：

sections.heading: 保留接近的方向
sections.body: 不要仅凭三字代码排除其他兴趣。分数接近、全高、全低或平均时，结合具体活动继续观察；不要为了某个代码调整答案。

pages.title: 二、把兴趣转成可验证的探索

sections.heading: 比较两个职业方向
sections.body: 阅读真实工作任务、技能、资格、工作条件与地区信息。兴趣只是判断的一部分，不证明你具备岗位胜任力。

sections.heading: 设计一次小尝试
sections.body: 选择课程练习、小项目或从业者访谈，观察自己是否愿意持续投入，同时记录实际困难。先获得反馈，再作重大决定。

sections.heading: 回看并更新判断
sections.body: 把喜欢、做得到、现实可行分别记录。一次尝试不必得出终身结论，可以保留、调整或暂缓某个方向。

sources: 费马测试：霍兰德职业兴趣测试及公开计分说明
RIASEC 解释与结果阅读指南

en.title: Holland Code Career Interest: Results and Exploration Worksheet
en.intro: Record your six interests and plan an exploration step. This is not a questionnaire, an official SDS or O*NET form, or an automatically generated personal report.

sections.heading: Keep the version and full profile
sections.body: Complete FermatMind's existing 60- or 140-question test first. Scores describe your position on this questionnaire's scale, not population percentiles, ability or employment success rates.
prompts: R Realistic: ____  I Investigative: ____  A Artistic: ____
S Social: ____  E Enterprising: ____  C Conventional: ____

sections.heading: Connect letters to activities
sections.body: R concerns practical work; I research and analysis; A creative expression; S helping and teaching; E organizing and influencing; C data, rules and order. Interests can coexist. Their order is not an ability ranking.
prompts: Two recent activities I enjoyed and would repeat:

sections.heading: Keep close interests in view
sections.body: Do not exclude interests based only on the three-letter code. When scores are close, high, low or flat, explore concrete activities. Do not change answers to force a preferred code.
prompts: What needs a new experience to check? __________________

pages.title: 2. Turn interests into an exploration step

sections.heading: Compare two career directions
sections.body: Read about actual tasks, skills, qualifications, conditions and regional information. Interests are one input, not evidence of job competence.

sections.heading: Plan a small experiment
sections.body: Try a course exercise, small project or conversation with someone in the field. Record both willingness to continue and practical difficulties. Gather feedback before a major decision.
prompts: Work sample or feedback to collect: ____________________

sections.heading: Review and update
sections.body: Separate enjoyment, capability and practical feasibility. One experiment does not need to settle a lifelong choice. Keep, adjust or pause a direction based on what you learn.
prompts: What skill or condition needs work? ____________________

sources: FermatMind Holland Code test and public scoring explanation
RIASEC model and results reading guide
